notes.title: Castle Wars VR Big Update!
notes.content:
A year later, as the game went into early access, we made a huge number of changes. The campaign and its plot component were completely redesigned.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zkCesQ1.gif[/img]
The gameplay has become even more tactical, thanks to the introduction of a new faction: Elves, who contribute to Castle Wars even more diverse units with their unique abilities.
Now, in addition to the deadly Fireball, in the arsenal of the player appeared the Magic Sword, capable of killing even the strongest unit of the enemy with one blow.
In addition, we added more than 10 new maps to the game and reworked the old ones to make the gameplay even more exciting.
All this and even more you can try now in Castle Wars VR, plunging into the atmosphere of colorful battles, where for victory you must become a real military commander, the commander of troops directly on the battlefield.
